route_title: 16-Layer Alternating Stack with Stochastic Jitter Initialization
compilation_rationale: Fixed 16-layer HfO2/SiO2 stack compiled per explicit sequence. Thickness bounds constrained to ±35% of user quarter-wave medians (155 nm HfO2, 230 nm SiO2). Spectral coverage spans 300–1700 nm. Normal-incidence unpolarized illumination applied. Two optimization targets enforce high reflectance in 300–450 nm and high transmittance in 1000–1700 nm.
